B = data('container_spec_memory_limit_bytes', filter=filter('deployment.environment', '*') and filter('service.name', '*')).max(by=['kubernetes_pod_uid', 'container_id']).above(0, inclusive=True).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (100*A/B).publish(label='C', enable=False)
F = (A*E).publish(label='F')
G = (C*E).publish(label='G')
D = data('k8s.container.ready', filter=filter('deployment.environment', '*') and filter('service.name', '*')).sum(by=['kubernetes_pod_uid', 'container_id']).publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (D/D).publish(label='E', enable=False)

chart.description: Slowest service endpoints (1-minute latency average)
chart.name: Top endpoints by latency
chart.programText:
filter_ = filter('deployment.environment', '*') and filter('service.name', '*') and filter('sf_operation', '*') and filter('sf_kind', 'SERVER', 'CONSUMER') and (not filter('sf_dimensionalized', '*')) and (not filter('sf_serviceMesh', '*'))
groupby = ['deployment.environment', 'service.name', 'sf_operation', 'sf_httpMethod']
allow_missing = ['sf_httpMethod']

A = histogram('spans', filter=filter_).percentile(pct=90, by=groupby, allow_missing=allow_missing).mean(over='1m').top(count=10).publish(label='A')
